_why_the_mirror_copy_is_never_deleted.claim: 23-ai-workforce-blueprint/templates/presentation-render/kie_generate.py is a LIVE dependency, not a retired path. Deleting or quarantining it breaks GHL media upload.
evidence: 06-ghl-install-pages/tools/ghl_media.py kie_generate_path() raises FileNotFoundError('reused KIE generator not found at ...') when that exact path is absent
06-ghl-install-pages/tools/ghl_image_stage.py step 4 calls ghl_media.generate_images, so the whole install-pages image stage rides on it
_why_the_mirror_copy_is_never_deleted.enforced_by: check-shared-script-drift.py CHECK A (live-dependency liveness) reads that constant with ast and FAILS if it no longer resolves to a file inside the mirror tree. It is not waivable.

evidence: Both copies carry the same prose LOCKSTEP NOTE naming the two paths and instructing 'Keep their LOGIC identical when editing either' — a requirement graded by nobody until this gate.

The role-library copy's own docstring records which way the port owes: 'FIX 68/67 STATUS (W21b): the role-library copy carries the platform-aware secrets order (presentation_job.oc_paths) AND the FIX 67 secret-name canon ... The presentation-render twin has NOT yet received that port — port the same four functions ... before claiming the two are logic-identical again.'

The presentations engine runs the role-library copy: presentation-canonical-entry.sh resolves --scripts-dir to that tree, and sales_checkout_builder.py / vsl_builder.py both shell `_here() / 'kie_generate.py'` from inside it.
The mirror copy is reached only by Skill 06 (ghl_media.py) — see _why_the_mirror_copy_is_never_deleted.
build_deck.py, the deterministic renderer the department actually runs, validates slides.json against the copy beside it in the role-library scripts tree.
The presentation-render copy sits beside render_deck.py, the older standalone renderer, and is not read by the engine.
